
        <h1>
            <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/mrpan0920/p/22650754" title="发布于 2026-08-24 10:57">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Rocky‑Linux‑10.2‑x86_64 Stratis 完整部署教程</span>
    

</a>

        </h1>
        <div class="postbody">
            <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h1>Rocky‑Linux‑10.2‑x86_64 Stratis 完整部署教程</h1>
<h1><span style="font-size: 14px">Stratis 是 RHEL 系新一代存储管理器，基于 XFS，支持</span><strong style="font-size: 14px">精简配置、自动扩容、快照、多磁盘组成存储池</strong><span style="font-size: 14px">，替代部分 LVM 场景。 ⚠️重要限</span></h1>
<h1><strong style="font-size: 14px">不支持 root 根文件系统</strong><span style="font-size: 14px">，仅用于数据盘；池创建后</span><strong style="font-size: 14px">不能加密</strong><span style="font-size: 14px">，加密只能创建池时指定；磁盘不能已有分区表 / 文件系统签名Red Hat。</span></h1>
<h2>环境准备</h2>
<p>系统：Rocky‑Linux‑10.2‑x86_64 新增磁盘示例：<code>/dev/sdb</code>（10G，用于 stratis 池）；多盘可以 <code>/dev/sdb /dev/sdc</code></p>
<h3 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i15.72ab2988x3k91x">1. 安装 Stratis 软件包</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">Stratis 由后台守护进程和命令行工具组成。首先，需要安装&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">stratisd</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（提供守护进程）和&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">stratis-cli</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">（提供命令行工具）</span></div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="sc-bRKDuR jCSJQZ highlighter-hljs"><code>1sudo yum install -y stratisd stratis-cli</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824101428902-271404733.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i19.72ab2988x3k91x">启动并设置开机自启</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">安装完成后，需要启动&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">stratisd</code><span class="qk-md-text complete"> 服务，并设置其在系统启动时自动运行：</span></div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="sc-bRKDuR jCSJQZ highlighter-hljs"><code>1sudo systemctl enable --now stratisd</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824101546554-1336627472.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i23.72ab2988x3k91x">&nbsp;创建存储池 (Pool)</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i24.72ab2988x3k91x">Stratis 的核心概念之一是存储池。你需要将一块或多块未使用的块设备（如&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">/dev/sdb</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）添加到池中</span></div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo stratis pool create mypool /dev/nvme0n2</code></pre>
<p>&nbsp;<img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824103931552-193142666.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i40.72ab2988x3k91x"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i41.72ab2988x3k91x">没有任何报错输出，说明你的 Stratis 存储池&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">mypool</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;已经</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">创建成功</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">了！🎉</span></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">接下来，你可以按照以下步骤，继续完成文件系统的创建、挂载以及开机自动挂载的配置：</span></div>
<h3 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i39.72ab2988x3k91x">1. 验证存储池是否创建成功</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">你可以运行以下命令查看当前系统中的 Stratis 池：</span></div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="language-plaintext highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo stratis pool list</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824104205794-28529126.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i45.72ab2988x3k91x">下一步：创建文件系统并挂载</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">现在存储池已经就绪，你可以继续完成文件系统的创建和挂载，将其用作&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">/data</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;目录：</span></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;在池中创建文件系统</span></strong></div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="sc-bRKDuR jCSJQZ highlighter-hljs" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i46.72ab2988x3k91x"><code>1sudo stratis fs create mypool myfs</code></pre>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824104341344-2015145976.png" class="lazyload"></span></strong></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">挂载到 </span><code class="qk-md-code">/data</code><span class="qk-md-text complete"> 目录</span></strong></div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="sc-bRKDuR jCSJQZ highlighter-hljs"><code>1sudo mkdir -p /data
2sudo mount /dev/stratis/mypool/myfs /data</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824104551290-1708951709.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i53.72ab2988x3k91x">别担心，这个提示</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">并不是报错</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">，而是&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">systemd</code><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i56.72ab2988x3k91x">&nbsp;发出的一个非常友好的</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">信息提示（Hint）</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></div>
<h3 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete">为什么会出现这个提示？</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">当你修改了&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">/etc/fstab</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;文件后，</span><code class="qk-md-code">systemd</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;仍然在内存中缓存着旧版本的挂载配置。当你使用&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">mount</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;命令时，它检测到配置文件已更新，就会提示你重新加载配置，以确保系统的挂载单元（</span><code class="qk-md-code">.mount</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">）与&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">fstab</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;保持一致</span><span class="options-item-Yv7oFR " data-index="2">2</span><span class="qk-md-text complete">。</span></div>
<h3 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;如何解决？</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">你只需要按照提示，重新加载一下&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">systemd</code><span class="qk-md-text complete"> 的配置即可：</span></div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="language-plaintext highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo systemctl daemon-reload</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824104707613-1038693757.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i59.72ab2988x3k91x"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i54.72ab2988x3k91x">执行完这条命令后，提示就会消失。你可以再次运行挂载命令来确认状态：</span></div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="language-bash highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo mount /dev/stratis/mypool/myfs /data</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824104822023-1584587681.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3 class="qk-md-head"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i64.72ab2988x3k91x">运维避坑指南（关键！）</span></h3>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete">在 Linux 运维中，修改&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">/etc/fstab</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;后有一个</span><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">黄金法则</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete">：</span><br><strong class="qk-md-strong complete"><span class="qk-md-text complete">绝对不要直接重启系统！</span></strong><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i65.72ab2988x3k91x"> 在重启之前，务必先运行以下命令进行测试：</span></div>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="language-css highlighter-hljs"><code>sudo mount -a</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824105029499-896786612.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><code class="qk-md-code" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i69.72ab2988x3k91x">mount -a</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;相当于&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">fstab</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的“试运行”命令。它会按文件逐行尝试挂载，如果配置有误（比如 UUID 写错、挂载点不存在等），它会立刻报错，方便你当场修正。如果&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">mount -a</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;没有任何报错输出，就说明你的&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">fstab</code><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i70.72ab2988x3k91x">&nbsp;配置完全正确，可以放心重启了</span></p>
<div class="qk-md-paragraph"><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i77.72ab2988x3k91x">现在，你的 Stratis 存储已经彻底部署完毕并投入使用了。你可以运行以下命令来做最后的验证：</span></div>
<div class="contain-layout-style relative mb-4 flex min-h-[2em] flex-col rounded-12 bg-capsule qw-md-code">
<div class="rounded-[12px] bg-[#fff]">
<div class="codeHighlighterWrapper-_O3AS8">
<pre class="sc-bRKDuR jCSJQZ highlighter-hljs"><code>1df -hT /data</code></pre>
<p><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3633685/202608/3633685-20260824105325554-1947105039.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><strong><span class="qk-md-text complete" data-spm-anchor-id="5176.28103460.0.i80.72ab2988x3k91x">完美！🎉 从&nbsp;</span><code class="qk-md-code">df -hT</code><span class="qk-md-text complete">&nbsp;的输出结果来看，你的 Stratis 存储已经彻底大功告成，并且完美运行！</span></strong></p>
</div>
</div>
